audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL-focused specs: EIP-606 (Homestead hardfork), Prague BLS12-381 precompiles, Prague SHA256 precompile, Prague point evaluation precompile (KZG), EIP-7880 (EXTCODEADDRESS for EOF/7702), EIP-7636 (ENR client identity), EIP-160 (EXP repricing), Cancun system instructions (CREATE/CALL/SELFDESTRUCT), and EIP-8070 (eth/71 blob transaction protocol).

out_of_scope: ENR client identity disclosure policy decisions

misclassified_entities.reason: Internal EVM component - contracts calling BLS12-381 precompiles are within the EL execution context
Internal EVM component - contracts calling G2 precompiles operate within the EL
Internal EVM component - contracts using pairing checks are within the EL
Internal EVM component - contracts calling SHA256 precompile are within the EL
Internal data flow - input to SHA256 precompile comes from EVM call data within execution context
Internal EVM component - contracts calling point evaluation precompile are within the EL
Internal EVM component - EOF contracts executing EXTCODEADDRESS operate within the EL
Internal EVM component - callers executing EXP opcode are within the EL execution context

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer (Homestead Fork - EIP-606)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P block propagation at Homestead activation (block 1,150,000)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers propagate blocks that must be validated against Homestead consensus changes (EIP-2 difficulty, EIP-7 DELEGATECALL, EIP-8 devp2p). Blocks before/after fork boundary require different validation rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller via BLS12-381 Precompiles
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: CALL to BLS12-381 precompile addresses (0x0b-0x12) with arbitrary input data
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any transaction can invoke BLS12-381 precompiles with arbitrary input. Input must be validated for correct point encoding, subgroup membership, and field element bounds. Invalid input consumes all gas and returns error.

trusted_external_entities.name: Delegated User Account (EIP-7880/7702)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Transaction from EIP-7702 delegated EOA queried via EXTCODEADDRESS
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Delegated user accounts have code set via EIP-7702. EXTCODEADDRESS must correctly resolve the underlying EOA address rather than the delegation target. Sponsored transaction flows depend on correct address resolution.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via ENR (EIP-7636)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: ENR record with optional 'client' key-value pair
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers advertise client identity via ENR records. Malicious peers can falsify client names/versions. Client identity data must never be used for security decisions. Useful only for network analytics.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Peer Spoofing ENR Client Identity
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: ENR record with falsified client identity data (EIP-7636)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Attackers can claim to run any client. Client field is informational only. Nodes must not make peering, routing, or trust decisions based on self-reported client identity.

trusted_external_entities.name: DoS Attacker via EXP Opcode (EIP-160)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Transaction with contract code using EXP opcode with large exponents
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Pre-EIP-160, EXP was underpriced allowing computational DoS. EIP-160 reprices to 50 gas per exponent byte. Attackers can still use EXP but at fair gas cost proportional to computation.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer via eth/71 Protocol (EIP-8070)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: eth/71 protocol messages for blob transaction announcement and retrieval
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers announce and serve blob transactions via eth/71. Malicious peers can announce non-existent blobs, serve invalid data, or refuse to provide blobs they claimed to have. Provider role claims must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Blob Data Provider Peer (EIP-8070)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: eth/71 GetPooledTransactions response with blob sidecars
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Provider peers claim to have full blob data. Blob commitments must be verified against KZG proofs. Peers failing to provide claimed data should be penalized and deprioritized.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Block validation at Homestead fork boundary (EIP-606)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blocks at fork boundary must be validated against correct ruleset. Block 1,150,000+ uses Homestead rules (EIP-2 difficulty adjustment, EIP-7 DELEGATECALL). Pre-fork blocks use Frontier rules.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: BLS12-381 precompile input validation (Prague fork, addresses 0x0b-0x12)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: All input validated: G1 points (128 bytes), G2 points (256 bytes), scalars (32 bytes). Subgroup checks required for G1/G2 points. Invalid encoding or non-subgroup points consume all gas. Pairing input must be multiple of 384 bytes.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: EXTCODEADDRESS opcode resolution for EIP-7702 delegated accounts (EIP-7880)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: EXTCODEADDRESS returns the account address itself (not the delegation target). Correct for sponsored transaction patterns where the original EOA address is needed for authorization.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: ENR record parsing with optional client key (EIP-7636)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Client identity is informational only. No security decisions based on self-reported client data. Malformed client entries must not crash ENR parser.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: ENR record with falsified client identity (EIP-7636)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Client field treated as untrusted metadata. No peering or routing decisions based on client identity. ENR signature validates record integrity but not content truthfulness.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: EXP opcode gas metering (EIP-160, Spurious Dragon)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Gas cost = 10 + 50 * byte_size_of_exponent. Prevents underpriced computation. Exponent of 0 costs only base 10 gas. Gas metering ensures fair resource consumption.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: eth/71 blob transaction announcement and retrieval protocol (EIP-8070)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blob announcements validated for structure and size. Blob data verified via KZG commitment checks. Peers tracked for provider/non-provider role. Unreliable providers deprioritized.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: eth/71 GetPooledTransactions response with blob sidecars (EIP-8070)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blob sidecars verified against KZG commitments in transaction. Provider peers that fail to serve claimed blobs are penalized. Blob data availability critical for L2 rollup security.
